requested_release: Moho Debut-equivalent features plus Astral tools on desktop, phones and tablets
reference_scope: Minimum confirmed requirements from the official Debut product page and the 14.5 announcement; an exhaustive edition-by-edition comparison remains required.

features.gap: Custom contour editing, cubic stroke smoothing, Boolean union/subtract/intersection/XOR and composited gradients exist. Independent Bezier tangent handles and keyed path morphing remain incomplete.
Procedural textured dab engine, pressure, pencil/ink/airbrush/chalk and custom local presets exist. Arbitrary texture-tip packs and a broad paint-bucket/brush ecosystem remain unfinished.
Normalized device pressure is recorded and rendered per stroke sample; mouse fallback and engine tests exist. Physical tablet/driver certification remains.

Native group/mask/supported blend graphs, ZIP-compressed 8-bit RGB layers and basic editable text. PSB/high-bit-depth/CMYK, mixed text styles, exact font metrics, clipping/adjustments/layer styles/vector masks remain non-equivalent.
Bone-angle-driven additive raster-pin correctives are available; arbitrary vector corrective actions and full Smart Bone equivalence remain.
MLS similarity pins and animated cubic curvers are available; ARAP/advanced cages and broad rig-deformation equivalence remain.
Batch tools operate on one layer/rig at a time.
Original editable tester scenes supplied; a broad licensed content pack is unfinished.
User-initiated bounded desktop capture implemented; synthetic WAV tests pass. Physical microphone/device interruption checks remain.

features.evidence: Native WAV/AIFF/MP3/M4A decoder, full-length import, speed/pitch, waveforms and editable timeline clips; code/tests in crates/astral-audio.

features.gap: Offline Rhubarb English/phonetic recognition produces distinct editable visemes with custom bitmap mouth mapping. Human review, language/noise quality certification and full facial performance remain required.
Rig motion paths exist; general object/path deformation parity is missing.
Bounded video sequences and reviewed camera/object tracking; two-point rotation/scale. Long-form streaming decoding and occlusion recovery remain.

Native AVI/MJPEG+PCM, PNG/JPEG, PNG sequences+WAV and WAV need no FFmpeg. MP4/WebM/GIF and hardware encoders still use FFmpeg. Native AVI is bounded to 2 GB; long-form NLE/color-management equivalence is incomplete.

features.evidence: 18 actions, persistent bindings, conflict rejection and actual shortcut labels; crates/astral/src/desktop/keymap.rs.

features.gap: English/Spanish/French core controls; advanced diagnostics and full-language/RTL coverage remain.

features.scope: Bounded DAG with source/solid/gradient/blend/mask/blur/color nodes. CPU node evaluation produces a shared viewport/export texture; not a GPU effects engine.
Five distinct previous saves, atomic publication and existing recovery copies. Recovery saves do not multiply backups.

features.gap: Two-second mixing blocks support output ranges up to six hours, with bounded decoded active sources. Individual source decoding and in-memory preview retain ten-minute limits; full long-form editing/streamed preview remain unfinished.
